    Installation

    Install FMOD for Unity under Assets first, add FMOD Plus through Git UPM, and then use the FMOD Plus Setup window to move FMOD to an Embedded UPM package.

    1. Install FMOD for Unity under Assets

    Install FMOD for Unity using the standard FMOD Integration workflow. At this stage, keep the integration in its traditional Assets location:

    Assets/Plugins/FMOD

    Open the Unity project and wait for FMOD for Unity to finish importing. FMOD Plus does not include FMOD for Unity, FMOD Studio, banks, or an FMOD license.

    Important

    Complete this Assets-based FMOD installation before running the FMOD Plus migration. The Setup window searches the Assets installation and prepares it for the move to Packages.

    2. Install FMOD Plus with Git UPM

    1. In Unity, open Window > Package Manager.
    2. Click + and choose Install package from git URL....

    1. Enter the following URL and click Install:
    https://github.com/NK-Studio/com.nkstudio.fmodplus.git

    3. Move FMOD to Packages

    After FMOD Plus has been installed successfully, open the following menu:

    FMOD > FMOD Plus > Setup

    The Setup window detects the FMOD Integration under Assets/Plugins/FMOD and displays the migration status, source version, target UPM version, destination, and GUID checks.

    Click Move FMOD to Packages. Review the confirmation dialog and continue with the migration.

    When the migration succeeds, the FMOD package is moved to:

    Packages/com.firelight.fmod-for-unity

    Project-specific FMOD Settings and Cache remain under Assets/Plugins/FMOD. Unity then recompiles the FMOD Plus Runtime and Editor assemblies against the detected FMOD package.

    Verify the installation

    After Unity finishes importing and compiling, verify that:

    • Package Manager shows FMOD Plus and com.firelight.fmod-for-unity.
    • FMOD > FMOD Plus > Setup reports the Embedded FMOD package as active.
    • FMOD Plus components such as FMOD Audio Source are available.
    • The Console has no FMOD or FMOD Plus compilation errors.
